notes: Issue #18 R1 source-independent coastal-region attribution. Only the ten iso_a2=='CN' coastal province rows used (Liaoning, Hebei, Tianjin, Shandong, Jiangsu, Shanghai, Zhejiang, Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi), dissolved per project region code in the analysis CRS. The polygons are land-based with generalised coastlines; seaward tidal-flat pixels fall outside them and are attributed by the documented centroid/nearest-province/reach/ambiguity rule (see scripts/analysis/labels/run_2020_scale_audit.py). This layer is independent of CMSA, CM-SSM and GEODATA. Kinmen/Matsu-context admin rows are not used for domain membership (Issue #17 remains owner-gated).
